{"status": "success", "summary": "Both independent deliverables are fixed and verified, and INDEX.md documents them.

Team split: I spawned one worker per independent part before doing any work myself — csvfix_worker (csvfix/impl.py) and rules_worker (rules/engine.py). Both workers made the edits but their sessions exposed no shell tool, so neither could execute the acceptance tests. I therefore ran the acceptance checks myself (I do have shell) and integrated.

Changes delivered:
- csvfix/impl.py: parse() strips each field and returns None unless the line has exactly 3 columns; total() takes column index 2 as the amount, skips blank/whitespace-only amounts, and coerces to int.
- rules/engine.py: evaluate() implements {"all": [...]} (True iff all named facts truthy, vacuous True on empty) and {"any": [...]} (True iff any truthy, False on empty); missing facts are falsy; returns real bools.
- INDEX.md: created, describing both deliverables and the verification commands/results.
- No test file was modified; test-file md5s still match the originals.

- Before edits I read all four source/test files.

- (cd rules && python3 -m pytest -q) -> "1 passed in 0.01s", EXIT=0
